title: The International meeting in the city
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：international　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 international 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the researcher wrote of ① an international meeting in the city in the paper, and everybody in the lab said at once that it was ② so international that nobody in the lab would go near it. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the researcher, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the international ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the international meeting in the city that anybody there had ever seen, or so the paper for February 1964 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too international to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the international ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an international team of doctors, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as international as the team of doctors they had once had in the old lab. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was international or not, and he said so.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was ⑦ something international, and nothing besides. The student from the next lab called the whole plan ⑧ quite international; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the paper kept the names of the international ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980, for the whole place, she wrote of another international meeting in the city in the same paper, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ no less international than anybody had expected. ⑩ The international team of doctors that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1982, was the one she could never quite name; the international ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 国际（前置定语 an international meeting in the city：1970 年研究员在研究报告里记下的那件国际的会议）
B. adj. 国际／跨国（两处加强说法：so international that … 与 no less international than …）
C. adj. 国际／跨国（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 国际（表语 too international to do：母亲觉得它太国际，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 跨国（前置定语 an international team of doctors：叔叔把整件事称作一桩跨国的医疗队）
F. adj. 跨国（同级比较 as international as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩跨国医疗队相比）
G. adj. 跨国（后置定语 something international：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 跨国（受程度副词修饰 quite international：那位学生的评价）

items.q: an international meeting in the city
the international meeting in the city that
The international team of doctors that

answers.why: international 意为“国际”，1970 年研究员在研究报告里记下的是“一件国际的会议”，此处作前置定语 an international meeting in the city。
international 意为“国际”，此处用 so international that 结构，说它国际到实验室里没人敢靠近。
international 意为“国际”，研究报告上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的国际城里的国际会议，等于最高级的说法。
international 意为“国际”，母亲认为这件东西“太国际了，谁也用不上”，too international to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
international 意为“跨国”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩跨国的医疗队”，此处作前置定语 an international team of doctors。
international 意为“跨国”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩跨国医疗队一样跨国”，同级比较用 as international as。
international 意为“跨国”，研究报告上那半行字要的是“跨国的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something international。
international 意为“跨国”，邻实验室来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当跨国”，quite 修饰原级 international。
international 意为“跨国”，no less international than 表示“其跨国不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之跨国不亚于任何人的预料。
international 意为“跨国”，母亲 1982 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的跨国医疗队”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，研究员在研究报告里记下了一件国际的会议。（an international meeting in the city）
它国际到实验室里没有一个人敢靠近。（so international that …）
母亲觉得它太国际，谁也用不上。（too international to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩跨国的医疗队。（an international team of doctors）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩跨国医疗队一样跨国。（as international as …）
到了 1977 年，研究报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件跨国的东西。（something international）
answers: In 1970 the researcher wrote of an international meeting in the city in the paper.
It was so international that nobody in the lab would go near it.
My mother thought it too international to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an international team of doctors.
He said nobody would call it as international as the team of doctors they had once had.
By 1977 the paper asked for nothing but something international.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 international 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the researcher wrote of an international meeting in the city in the paper, and nobody forgot it.
It was the international meeting in the city that anybody there had ever seen, or so the paper says.
My mother thought it too international to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an international team of doctors, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next lab called the plan quite international, and everybody laughed.
The international ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
